changes: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon (announced 2026-10-28) is added as a gated, defender-first frontier model with self-reported, guardrails-off cyber scores that set new highs on ExploitGym (54.8%), SEC-bench Pro (88.2%) and CWE-bench (71.0%) — none independently replicated, and no public API exists to replicate them. On the incident side, three new AI-involved intrusions landed in 72 hours: GitBook (AI-agent-driven), WorkOS (ARTEX AI framework) and Binance's $6.43B heist (abused AI tool), plus a lower-confidence 3AM ransomware case.
incident: GitBook discloses AI-agent-driven intrusion exposing infrastructure credentials and Assistant query logs
incident: WorkOS says an attacker used the ARTEX AI framework to breach an internal sales application
incident: Binance attributes $6.43B theft partly to abuse of an AI tool after rigged coding-assignment lures
incident (unconfirmed, hidden): 3AM ransomware affiliate shows AI-like command loops in European school attack
